name: thin_outreach
why:
The resume is fine and the covering letter says nothing. S8's message check is a guarantee like the validator's, and this is the case that holds it to that - a letter under 40 words cannot have said anything specific about this role, and the gate should show the complaint beside the text rather than letting it go out looking polished.

It exists because the first run of this suite printed exactly this complaint four times, to stderr, and recorded none of it. The harness was discarding a finding.

Backend Engineer - Annova

We are hiring a Backend Engineer to own our data platform. You will build and
maintain services in Python and FastAPI, and work with PostgreSQL at scale.

- Experience with FastAPI or a similar framework
- Comfortable with PostgreSQL
- Kubernetes experience is a plus

Send your application to careers@annova.example.com.
